name: Assassin
description: An assassin’s art is a quick and sure death, delivered without remorse or hesitation. Typically employed by a political state or criminal syndicate, assassins quickly learn to make use of any weapon available, including the weapons of their own targets. This makes them extremely versatile adventurers, able to adapt to nearly any combat situation as the need arises.

How many targets have you killed?
Do you remember your first kill?
How did you acquire your unique skillset?
Does your character struggle with any form of guilt?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

An adventurer's pack, containing:.name: Barbarian
An adventurer's pack, containing:.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.
backstoryPrompts: Have you always been strong, or did you go through a lot of training?
Is your immense brawn shared by other members of your family or tribe?
When did you first discover that rage could make you stronger?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
An adventurer's pack, containing:.coreAbilityDescription: You may spend 3 willpower to enter a rage for 5 combat turns. During a rage, your strength is increased by 3. If you are not wearing armor, you also gain 3 resistance to bludgeoning, slashing, piercing, and fire damage. You may not cast spells, read scrolls, or use consumables without ending your rage. Note: when an ability increases your rage level, it increases your strength and resistance by the indicated amount and also resets the rage duration to 5 turns.

_.coreAbilityDescription: You may spend 3 willpower to enter a rage for 5 combat turns. During a rage, your strength is increased by 3. _.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

_.coreAbilityDescription: You may spend 3 willpower to enter a rage for 5 combat turns. During a rage, your strength is increased by 3. Note: when an ability increases your rage level, it increases your strength and resistance by the indicated amount and also resets the rage duration to 5 turns.

One of the following items:.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

limitations.name: Barbarian

1.name: Barbarian
1.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

Is your immense brawn shared by other members of your family or tribe?
When did you first discover that rage could make you stronger?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
1.coreAbilityDescription: You may spend 3 willpower to enter a rage for 5 combat turns. During a rage, your strength is increased by 3. If you are not wearing armor, you also gain 3 resistance to bludgeoning, slashing, piercing, and fire damage. You may not cast spells, read scrolls, or use consumables without ending your rage. Note: when an ability increases your rage level, it increases your strength and resistance by the indicated amount and also resets the rage duration to 5 turns.

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.
_.backstoryPrompts: Have you always been strong, or did you go through a lot of training?
Is your immense brawn shared by other members of your family or tribe?
When did you first discover that rage could make you stronger?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: You may spend 3 willpower to enter a rage for 5 combat turns. During a rage, your strength is increased by 3. If you are not wearing armor, you also gain 3 resistance to bludgeoning, slashing, piercing, and fire damage. You may not cast spells, read scrolls, or use consumables without ending your rage. Note: when an ability increases your rage level, it increases your strength and resistance by the indicated amount and also resets the rage duration to 5 turns.
_.limitations: Due to their careless approach and lack of formal education, barbarians start with a deficiency in two of the following three skills: {{skills.sorcery}}, {{skills.literacy}}, {{skills.stealth}}.
_.1: Gain proficiency in two of these skills: {{skills.initiative}}, {{skills.mobility}}, or {{skills.survival}}.
_.2: you develop a terrifying primal roar. As an action, you can spend 1 willpower to roar, potentially terrifying nearby enemies. Each enemy must pass an {{attr.NST}} saving throw or become {{status.terrified}}. The DT of the saving throw is equal to your {{attr.NST}} attribute score.
_.3: Learn the {{maneuvers.cleaving_strike}} combat ability. You can use the cleaving strike ability even when dealing bludgeoning damage.
_.4: your rage deepens. When you get a kill during a rage, you can expend 1 willpower to increase your rage level by 1.
_.5: your proficiency in martial arts advances to expertise.
_.6: magic is stupid, but you can make it go away by yelling at it. Enemies which fail their saving throw against your roar may not cast spells on their next turn, and lose concentration on any spells they have already cast.
_.7: increase your proficiency level in one of these skills: initiative, mobility, or survival.
_.8: your rage sustains you in your darkest hour. Once per turn, when you take damage while below half hp, your rage level increases by 1.
_.11: Your skill in martial arts advances to mastery.
_.14: increase your proficiency level in two of these skills: initiative, mobility, or survival.
_.15: gain the ability to enter a blackout rage. Entering a blackout rage costs 10 willpower, and immediately increases your rage level to 10 (instead of 3). As a monk, you keep your barbarian starting gear and proficiencies, but lose your barbarian rage ability and class abilities.

_.name: Crusader
_.description: The crusader offers their services to a chosen deity by swearing a sincere theological oath. As long as the oath is kept, their powers never wane and their enemies are smitten down before them. But even the most devoted mortal may at times be sorely tempted to break such an oath. Should the temptation prove too much, the crusader may find themselves tumbling down the dark path of the oathbreaker.

_.coreAbilityDescription: Having taken a solemn oath of service before your God, you may call upon divine providence to bolster you and your allies. _.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. _.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. _.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

Have you always had a close connection to nature, or did something spur that connection?
What was your first transformation like?
Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. _.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Crusader
_.description: The crusader offers their services to a chosen deity by swearing a sincere theological oath. As long as the oath is kept, their powers never wane and their enemies are smitten down before them. But even the most devoted mortal may at times be sorely tempted to break such an oath. Should the temptation prove too much, the crusader may find themselves tumbling down the dark path of the oathbreaker.

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>
_.backstoryPrompts: How did you learn to transform into your specific animal?
Have you always had a close connection to nature, or did something spur that connection?
What was your first transformation like?
Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: You expend 3 willpower to transform into your chosen animal for up to one hour. Your clothing and worn items merge with your beast form, and return upon detransformation. While transformed, your physical attributes ({{attr.STR}}, {{attr.DEX}}, {{attr.SPD}}) change to that of your chosen form.
_.1: gain proficiency in {{skills.survival}}.
_.5: You may cast nature spells while transformed.

_.name: Inquisitor
_.description: Often clad in black armor and concealed beneath a dark hood or mask, the inquisitor’s dark countenance usually conceals and ever darker heart. An inquisitor has been called by their deity to drive out heresy, and will not hesitate to interrogate or kill anyone who stands in his or her way. Inquisitors are perhaps best known for branding their opponents as heretics, marking them for divine retribution.
_.backstoryPrompts: How did you come to choose to serve your god?
Is your persecution of heretics commanded by god directly, or through a religious institution?
Do you have any moral qualms about the suffering you bring to the enemies of your god?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: In addition to your regular equipment, you have a special branding iron obtained from your chosen deity. This iron is imbued with divine magic and cannot be heated by ordinary means, but you may expend 2 AP to whisper a short prayer or sacred word, causing the end of the brand to glow blazing hot for 1 minute. Your brand is a standard melee weapon that deals 1d6 piercing damage plus your {{attr.CHA}} modifier in fire damage. Enemies struck by this weapon also receive the heretic’s brand, marking them for divine retribution.
_.limitations: As an inquisitor, you have a deficiency in {{skills.accuracy}}, {{skills.medicine}}, {{skills.nature}}.
_.1: gain proficiency in {{skills.sorcery}} and {{skills.perception}}.
_.3: getting hurt only strengthens your holy resolve. When you take more than 6 damage at once, gain one willpower.
_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. _.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Inquisitor
_.description: Often clad in black armor and concealed beneath a dark hood or mask, the inquisitor’s dark countenance usually conceals and ever darker heart. _.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. _.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Barbarian

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

Have you always had a close connection to nature, or did something spur that connection?
What was your first transformation like?
Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Inquisitor
_.description: Often clad in black armor and concealed beneath a dark hood or mask, the inquisitor’s dark countenance usually conceals and ever darker heart. _.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. _.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>
_.backstoryPrompts: How did you learn to transform into your specific animal?
Have you always had a close connection to nature, or did something spur that connection?
What was your first transformation like?
Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: You expend 3 willpower to transform into your chosen animal for up to one hour. Your clothing and worn items merge with your beast form, and return upon detransformation. While transformed, your physical attributes ({{attr.STR}}, {{attr.DEX}}, {{attr.SPD}}) change to that of your chosen form.
_.1: gain proficiency in {{skills.survival}}.
_.5: You may cast nature spells while transformed.
_.Two of the following:: A pet, such as a {{animals.cat}}, {{animals.dog}}, {{animals.parrot}}, or {{animals.monkey}}
_.name: Inquisitor
_.description: Often clad in black armor and concealed beneath a dark hood or mask, the inquisitor’s dark countenance usually conceals and ever darker heart. An inquisitor has been called by their deity to drive out heresy, and will not hesitate to interrogate or kill anyone who stands in his or her way. Inquisitors are perhaps best known for branding their opponents as heretics, marking them for divine retribution.
_.backstoryPrompts: How did you come to choose to serve your god?
Is your persecution of heretics commanded by god directly, or through a religious institution?
Do you have any moral qualms about the suffering you bring to the enemies of your god?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: In addition to your regular equipment, you have a special branding iron obtained from your chosen deity. This iron is imbued with divine magic and cannot be heated by ordinary means, but you may expend 2 AP to whisper a short prayer or sacred word, causing the end of the brand to glow blazing hot for 1 minute. Your brand is a standard melee weapon that deals 1d6 piercing damage plus your {{attr.CHA}} modifier in fire damage. Enemies struck by this weapon also receive the heretic’s brand, marking them for divine retribution.
_.limitations: As an inquisitor, you have a deficiency in {{skills.accuracy}}, {{skills.medicine}}, {{skills.nature}}.
_.1: gain proficiency in {{skills.sorcery}} and {{skills.perception}}.
_.3: getting hurt only strengthens your holy resolve. When you take more than 6 damage at once, gain one willpower.
_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor
_.backstoryPrompts: Did you train as a page or a squire before becoming a knight?
Are you proud of your country and your liege, or have you become disillusioned?
Was your oath of fealty inspired by love, respect, or political convenience?
How far back can you trace your lineage?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn. By tapping into primal rage, barbarians can strike harder and faster than anyone else while laughing off blows that would stagger an ordinary man. Barbarians typically wear light armor, and swing the largest weapons they can find. Their bodies are often covered in scars, either from tribal initiation rituals, or past battles. Some barbarians channel their rage in a drunken stupor, while others transform into the animals that embody their inner beast.

_.coreAbilityDescription: You may spend 3 willpower to enter a rage for 5 combat turns. During a rage, your strength is increased by 3. _.name: Crusader
_.description: The crusader offers their services to a chosen deity by swearing a sincere theological oath. As long as the oath is kept, their powers never wane and their enemies are smitten down before them. But even the most devoted mortal may at times be sorely tempted to break such an oath. Should the temptation prove too much, the crusader may find themselves tumbling down the dark path of the oathbreaker.

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Inquisitor
_.description: Often clad in black armor and concealed beneath a dark hood or mask, the inquisitor’s dark countenance usually conceals and ever darker heart. _.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Should the temptation prove too much, the crusader may find themselves tumbling down the dark path of the oathbreaker.
_.backstoryPrompts: What made you swear fealty to one particular deity?
Do you ever feel tempted to break your oath?
Is your god pleased with your service, or are you on shaky terms?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: Having taken a solemn oath of service before your God, you may call upon divine providence to bolster you and your allies. _.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>
_.backstoryPrompts: How did you learn to transform into your specific animal?
Have you always had a close connection to nature, or did something spur that connection?
What was your first transformation like?
Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: You expend 3 willpower to transform into your chosen animal for up to one hour. Your clothing and worn items merge with your beast form, and return upon detransformation. While transformed, your physical attributes ({{attr.STR}}, {{attr.DEX}}, {{attr.SPD}}) change to that of your chosen form.

_.5: You may cast nature spells while transformed.

_.name: Inquisitor
_.description: Often clad in black armor and concealed beneath a dark hood or mask, the inquisitor’s dark countenance usually conceals and ever darker heart. An inquisitor has been called by their deity to drive out heresy, and will not hesitate to interrogate or kill anyone who stands in his or her way. Inquisitors are perhaps best known for branding their opponents as heretics, marking them for divine retribution.
_.backstoryPrompts: How did you come to choose to serve your god?
Is your persecution of heretics commanded by god directly, or through a religious institution?
Do you have any moral qualms about the suffering you bring to the enemies of your god?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: In addition to your regular equipment, you have a special branding iron obtained from your chosen deity. This iron is imbued with divine magic and cannot be heated by ordinary means, but you may expend 2 AP to whisper a short prayer or sacred word, causing the end of the brand to glow blazing hot for 1 minute. Your brand is a standard melee weapon that deals 1d6 piercing damage plus your {{attr.CHA}} modifier in fire damage. Enemies struck by this weapon also receive the heretic’s brand, marking them for divine retribution.
_.limitations: As an inquisitor, you have a deficiency in {{skills.accuracy}}, {{skills.medicine}}, {{skills.nature}}.

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Inquisitor

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

Have you always had a close connection to nature, or did something spur that connection?
What was your first transformation like?
Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. _.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

_.description: Often clad in black armor and concealed beneath a dark hood or mask, the inquisitor’s dark countenance usually conceals and ever darker heart. An inquisitor has been called by their deity to drive out heresy, and will not hesitate to interrogate or kill anyone who stands in his or her way. Inquisitors are perhaps best known for branding their opponents as heretics, marking them for divine retribution.
_.backstoryPrompts: How did you come to choose to serve your god?
Is your persecution of heretics commanded by god directly, or through a religious institution?
Do you have any moral qualms about the suffering you bring to the enemies of your god?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?
_.coreAbilityDescription: In addition to your regular equipment, you have a special branding iron obtained from your chosen deity. This iron is imbued with divine magic and cannot be heated by ordinary means, but you may expend 2 AP to whisper a short prayer or sacred word, causing the end of the brand to glow blazing hot for 1 minute. Your brand is a standard melee weapon that deals 1d6 piercing damage plus your {{attr.CHA}} modifier in fire damage. Enemies struck by this weapon also receive the heretic’s brand, marking them for divine retribution.

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Hermit
_.description:
A hermit is someone who has chosen to live alone, usually on the outskirts of civilization. Such prolonged solitude leaves one with countless hours of quiet contemplation, and the slow progression from idiosyncrasy to eccentricity and madness. Alone in the wilderness, it is only a matter of time before one's most savage and primal instincts begin to dominate. Then comes the choice of whether to resist the madness or embrace it wholeheartedly, but this too is only a matter of time. In the end, there comes a day when that which lumbers out of the hermit's hut is more beast than man.

Whether by some inborn ability or through countless hours of meditation, a hermit is someone who has developed the ability to transform at will into a particular animal. Unlike a druid who can transform into a wide variety of small animals, a hermit can only transform into one type of animal. But what a hermit sacrifices in flexibility, they gain in power. Hermits are known for transforming into mighty animals such as the direwolf, rune bear, lions, and even the mighty rhinoceros.<>

What was your first transformation like?
Do you feel more at home as a humanoid or as an animal?
What made you leave your previous life and start adventuring?

_.name: Knight
_.description: The knight is a low-ranking noble with formal combat training. Although they may be called to fight in battle, a knight’s primary purpose is to serve for the glory of their Lord or Lady, to whom they have sworn an oath of fealty. Many knights are also accompanied by a squire, a young knight in training who may carry their lord’s banner or help them don and doff their armor. On the battlefield, a knight is a magnificent sight, clad in expensive steel plate armor and with their lord’s ensignia emblazoned on their shield. However, some knights forgo a shield altogether, preferring a heavier two-handed weapon. Either way, knights train extensively and are rarely caught flat-footed, even when out of armor

_.name: Barbarian
_.description: Whether a local farmhand or a tribesman from a remote tundra or jungle, barbarians are united by their unparalleled fury in battle, as well as sheer physical brawn.
